title.zh-CN: 气短、痰中带血与双腿胀痛 · 30岁女性
title.en: Breathlessness, blood-streaked sputum and aching legs · 30-year-old woman

summary.zh-CN: 30岁女性，咳嗽、活动后气短伴胸痛半个月，这三天加重，两条腿也胀痛、肿了：在病房接诊她，解读入院检查，决定当天的治疗并规划此后的随访。
summary.en: A 30-year-old woman has had two weeks of cough, breathlessness on exertion and chest pain, worse for three days, and her legs ache and have swollen: see her on the ward, make sense of the admission tests, decide on the first day's treatment and plan what follows.

notes.zh-CN: 依据单篇已发表病例报告改编。本版（1.1.0）的患者事实全部沿用 1.0.0 版从报告中提取的内容——30岁女性，咳嗽、少量白痰偶带血丝、活动后气短（休息缓解）、偶发与呼吸咳嗽劳累无关的阵发性钝痛半个月，近3天加重；双下肢先胀痛、后出现可凹性水肿；数年前诊断“特发性血小板减少”；胆囊切除；一次死胎、无流产；无烟酒嗜好；无明显发绀、双肺呼吸音清无啰音、双下肢轻度凹陷性水肿、血压 130/80 mmHg；CT 双肺动脉及右下肺静脉充盈缺损；左股浅静脉和右腘静脉血栓；血小板 58×10⁹/L、APTT 71.6 s、INR 正常、D-二聚体 902 μg/L；凝血因子Ⅷ、Ⅸ、Ⅺ无异常；ANA谱、ANCA、补体等未见异常；抗心磷脂抗体 104 U/mL（参考 0–12）；肝素后转华法林，同时使用激素并逐渐停用；3 个月CT示血栓消失、血小板改善、无复发报告——均尚未对照原文全文核对。患者为化名，医院和日期已去除，时间以相对时间表示。分阶段设计（CT、超声和首批血液检查放在入院当天，凝血因子、自身抗体和抗心磷脂抗体放在住院期间——1.0.0 版没有记录任何检查的具体时间）、决策、处置选项、评分、医护角色和患者说出的担忧（教学设定，不增加临床事实）均为教学设计；1.0.0 版没有记录的内容（其他生命体征、右心评估、抗体同型、狼疮抗凝物和抗β2GPI、死胎孕周、体重、肾功能、药物剂量）保持未知。1.0.0 版中英文稿的差异（中文写明低分子肝素、英文只写肝素；中文为左股浅静脉、英文为左股静脉）两种说法都保留，并列入导师指南的待核实清单。本例没有获准展示的原图。
notes.en: Adapted from a single published case report. Every patient fact in this version (1.1.0) is one that version 1.0.0 extracted from the report — a 30-year-old woman with two weeks of cough with a little white, occasionally blood-streaked sputum, breathlessness on exertion relieved by rest and occasional paroxysmal dull chest pain unrelated to breathing, coughing or exertion, all worse for three days; legs that ached and later developed pitting oedema; 'idiopathic thrombocytopenia' diagnosed years earlier; a cholecystectomy; one stillbirth and no miscarriage; no smoking or alcohol; no obvious cyanosis, clear lungs without crackles, mild bilateral pitting oedema and BP 130/80 mmHg; CT filling defects in both pulmonary arteries and the right lower pulmonary vein; left superficial femoral and right popliteal vein thrombosis; platelets 58 × 10⁹/L, APTT 71.6 s, normal INR, D-dimer 902 µg/L; normal factors VIII, IX and XI; unremarkable ANA panel, ANCA and complement; anticardiolipin 104 U/mL (reference 0–12); heparin then warfarin, with steroids given alongside and tapered; clots resolved on CT at 3 months, platelets improved, no recurrence reported — and none has yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals and dates are removed and time is relative. The staging (the CT, ultrasound and first blood tests on the day of admission; the factor assays, autoantibodies and anticardiolipin during the admission — 1.0.0 times none of the tests), decisions, intervention options, scoring, staff and the patient's voiced worries (a teaching device that adds no clinical fact) are teaching design; what 1.0.0 does not record (other vital signs, right-heart assessment, the antibody isotype, lupus anticoagulant and anti-β2GPI, the stillbirth's gestation, weight, renal function, drug doses) stays unknown. Where the Chinese and English texts of 1.0.0 differ (low-molecular-weight heparin in Chinese, heparin in English; the left superficial femoral vein in Chinese, the left femoral vein in English) both readings are kept and listed in the facilitator guide's 'To verify'. No figure of the report is approved for display.

guidelines: EULAR 2019 management of antiphospholipid syndrome in adults
ISTH SSC 2020 lupus anticoagulant detection and interpretation (update)
ISTH SSC 2018 cancer-associated thrombosis with thrombocytopenia
ACR 2020 reproductive health in rheumatic and musculoskeletal diseases

notes.en: AI-assisted teaching design with an editorial review against the cited guidance. The patient facts are those extracted from the published report for version 1.0.0; they have not yet been checked against the full source article. The case is not yet reviewed by a licensed clinician.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例回看，仅供临床教育，不用于个体诊疗或自行用药。病程和结果均来自原报告，不模拟未记录的生理变化。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for clinical education, not for individual care or self-medication. The course and results come from the report; unrecorded physiological changes are not simulated.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 把血栓患者单独延长的 APTT（INR 正常）识别为狼疮抗凝物样的改变——提示易栓而不是出血倾向——并在不推迟抗凝的前提下，于首剂肝素前送检狼疮抗凝物、抗心磷脂抗体和抗β2糖蛋白Ⅰ抗体（ISTH SSC 2020）。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise an isolated prolonged APTT with a normal INR in a patient with venous thrombosis as a probable lupus-anticoagulant effect — a clotting, not a bleeding, tendency — and send lupus anticoagulant, anticardiolipin and anti-β2-glycoprotein I tests before the first heparin dose where this does not delay treatment (ISTH SSC 2020).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 对血压正常、血小板 58×10⁹/L、偶有痰中带血的双侧肺栓塞合并深静脉血栓，确诊当天开始按体重给药的治疗剂量低分子肝素并每天复查血小板；不溶栓、不放下腔静脉滤器、不为“先升血小板”推迟抗凝（ESC 2019；AHA/ACC 2026；ISTH SSC 2018）。
learningOutcomes.en: Start weight-based treatment-dose LMWH on the day of diagnosis for normotensive bilateral PE with DVT, a platelet count of 58 × 10⁹/L and occasional blood-streaked sputum, with daily platelet counts — no thrombolysis, no IVC filter and no delay to raise the platelets first (ESC 2019; AHA/ACC 2026; ISTH SSC 2018).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 解释一次抗心磷脂抗体 104 U/mL（参考值 0–12）、未注明同型、没有抗β2GPI 和狼疮抗凝物结果，按 2023 ACR/EULAR 抗磷脂综合征分类标准能说明什么、不能说明什么，并在按抗磷脂综合征治疗的同时安排至少 12 周后复查。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain what one anticardiolipin result of 104 U/mL (reference 0–12) without isotype, anti-β2GPI or lupus anticoagulant can and cannot establish under the 2023 ACR/EULAR APS classification criteria, and arrange repeat testing at least 12 weeks later while treating her as having APS.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 为血栓性抗磷脂综合征制定长期抗凝方案：华法林与肝素重叠至少 5 天、直到 INR 达 2.0–3.0，此后维持 INR 2.0–3.0、不设停药期限，不用直接口服抗凝药（ESC 2019；EULAR 2019；AHA/ACC 2026）。
learningOutcomes.en: Plan long-term anticoagulation for thrombotic antiphospholipid syndrome: warfarin overlapping heparin for at least 5 days and until the INR is 2.0–3.0, then INR 2.0–3.0 with no planned stop, and no direct oral anticoagulant (ESC 2019; EULAR 2019; AHA/ACC 2026).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 为即将服用华法林的育龄女性提供咨询：先做妊娠试验，不用含雌激素的避孕方法（ACR 2020），任何妊娠都与专科提前计划，确认妊娠后改为治疗剂量低分子肝素加小剂量阿司匹林（EULAR 2019）。
learningOutcomes.en: Counsel a woman of reproductive age who is starting warfarin: a pregnancy test first, no oestrogen-containing contraception (ACR 2020), and any pregnancy planned with the specialists, changing to treatment-dose LMWH plus low-dose aspirin once pregnancy is confirmed (EULAR 2019).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 对照报告的治疗经过（肝素后改华法林，同时使用激素并逐渐停用）与现行做法：血小板 ≥ 30×10⁹/L 且无明显出血时不常规使用糖皮质激素（ASH 2019，免疫性血小板减少症），激素也绝不能代替抗凝。
learningOutcomes.en: Compare the reported course — heparin then warfarin, with steroids given alongside and tapered — with current practice: no routine corticosteroids for a platelet count ≥ 30 × 10⁹/L without significant bleeding (ASH 2019, immune thrombocytopenia), and never steroids in place of anticoagulation.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 咳嗽、气短、胸口痛半个月了，这三天更厉害。
chiefComplaint.en: I've had a cough, shortness of breath and chest pain for two weeks, and the last three days it's worse.

triageNote.zh-CN: 30岁女性，因咳嗽、活动后气短伴胸痛半个月、近3天加重收入病房；偶有痰中带血，双下肢胀痛、肿胀。血压 130/80 mmHg。
triageNote.en: 30-year-old woman admitted to the ward with two weeks of cough, breathlessness on exertion and chest pain, worse for three days; occasional blood-streaked sputum and aching, swollen legs. Blood pressure 130/80 mmHg.

personality.zh-CN: 30岁女性，半个月来咳嗽、一活动就喘，胸口时不时隐隐作痛，这三天更重，两条腿又胀又肿，今天住进病房，心里很紧张。她说话清楚、配合，自己知道的都愿意说：几年前查出血小板低、切过胆囊，也经历过一次死胎——说到那次怀孕会难过。不知道的事直说不知道，从不猜。
personality.en: A 30-year-old woman who has had a cough and has been getting breathless whenever she exerts herself for two weeks, with a dull ache in her chest now and then, all worse for three days, and whose legs have started to ache and swell. Admitted to the ward today and anxious. She is clear and cooperative and tells what she knows — low platelets found years ago, her gallbladder operation, and a baby who was stillborn, which upsets her to talk about. When she does not know something she says so and never guesses.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 日常口语，句子完整；躺着休息时说话不喘；不用医学术语，只会复述医生以前告诉她的诊断名称。
speechStyle.en: Everyday speech in whole sentences; resting in bed she talks without getting breathless. No medical terms, except a diagnosis a doctor once told her.

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生，我咳嗽、一活动就喘，已经半个月了，这三天更厉害，痰里有时候还带点血丝。
openingLine.en: Doctor, I've had this cough and I get out of breath whenever I do anything — two weeks now, and worse these last three days. Sometimes there's a streak of blood in what I cough up.

concerns.zh-CN: 咳出血丝来，是不是很严重？
concerns.en: Is it serious, coughing up blood like this?
Will I still be able to have a baby?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 扮演者：入院第一阶段，她躺在病床上，安静休息时说话不喘，偶尔咳嗽；紧张但配合。她只说自己知道的：咳嗽、少量白痰偶带血丝、一活动就喘、歇一会儿能缓解、胸口偶尔阵发闷痛（与喘气、咳嗽、劳累无明显关系）、这三天都加重；两条腿先胀痛、后来肿了、一按一个坑；几年前查出血小板低（医生说是“特发性血小板减少”，细节记不清）；切过胆囊（年份说不准）；有过一次死胎，没有流过产，那次怀孕几周记不清；不抽烟、不喝酒。不说任何化验或检查数字，不编造用药、过敏、家族史、体重、月经、避孕或发热情况；问到这些就说说不上来。说到死胎时会停顿、声音变低。住院期间她的症状有什么变化，本病例没有记录：被问到现在感觉怎样，就说说不清。
actingNotes.en: For the actor: in the first phase she is lying in her ward bed, not breathless while resting and talking, coughing now and then; anxious but cooperative. She says only what she knows: a cough with a little white phlegm, now and then streaked with blood; getting out of breath whenever she does anything, settling with rest; an occasional dull ache in the chest that comes and goes, with no clear link to breathing, coughing or exertion; all worse these three days; legs that ached first and then swelled, leaving a dent when pressed; low platelets found a few years ago ('idiopathic thrombocytopenia', the doctor said; she does not remember the details); her gallbladder out (she cannot say which year); one stillborn baby, no miscarriage, and she cannot remember how many weeks pregnant she was. No smoking, no alcohol. She never gives numbers or test results and never invents medicines, allergies, family history, weight, periods, contraception or fevers — asked about these, she says she cannot say. She pauses and speaks more quietly when the stillbirth comes up. The case does not record how she felt later in the admission: asked how she feels now, she says she cannot really say.

label.en: Day of admission: at the bedside on the ward

description.zh-CN: 她因咳嗽、活动后气短伴胸痛半个月、近三天加重收入病房，双腿胀痛、肿胀。你在床旁问诊、查体，开出并解读首批检查，决定当天的治疗。
description.en: Admitted to the ward with two weeks of cough, breathlessness on exertion and chest pain, worse for three days, and aching, swollen legs. At the bedside: take her history, examine her, order and read the first tests and decide on today's treatment.

label.zh-CN: 住院期间：进一步检查回报
label.en: During the admission: further results back

description.zh-CN: 为查明凝血异常和血栓原因而送检的项目陆续回报。判断这些结果能说明什么、不能说明什么，规划长期抗凝，并和她谈今后的打算。
description.en: The tests sent to explain the clotting abnormality and the cause of the clots are back. Decide what they do and do not establish, plan her long-term anticoagulation and talk with her about the future.

description.zh-CN: 住院后的治疗、3 个月时的复查和此后的随访：本病例记录的经过。

name.zh-CN: 记录的治疗经过与结局

text.zh-CN: 抗凝先用肝素（本记录中文稿写明为低分子肝素，英文稿只写“肝素”），之后改为华法林；同时使用激素，以后逐渐停用。3 个月时复查CT，血栓消失；血小板改善。随访中没有复发的报告，随访总时长不清楚。
text.en: Anticoagulation began with heparin (specified as low-molecular-weight heparin in the Chinese text of this record; the English text says only 'heparin') and was changed to warfarin; steroids were given at the same time and later tapered off. A CT at 3 months showed that the clots had resolved, and the platelet count improved. No recurrence was reported; the total length of follow-up is not clear.

note.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录各药的剂量、目标 INR 和 INR 数值、所用激素的名称、随访期间的血小板数值、有无出血，也没有记录任何抗体复查。报告的诊断为原发性抗磷脂综合征。
note.en: This case does not record the doses, the INR target or values, which steroid was used, the platelet counts during follow-up or any bleeding, and records no repeat antibody test. The report's diagnosis was primary antiphospholipid syndrome.

source.zh-CN: 报告·治疗与转归（低分子肝素/肝素后转华法林，激素逐渐停用；3 个月CT血栓消失，血小板改善，无复发报告，随访时长未明）——依 1.0.0 版提取，尚未对照原文全文核对
source.en: Report: treatment and outcome (LMWH/heparin then warfarin, steroids tapered; CT at 3 months: clots resolved; platelets improved; no recurrence reported; follow-up length unclear) — as extracted for version 1.0.0; not yet checked against the full article

name.zh-CN: 建立静脉通路并留取血标本

dose.zh-CN: 外周静脉留置针一条；同时抽取血常规、凝血和易栓相关抗体等标本——在首剂肝素之前抽取，但不为此推迟抗凝。
dose.en: One peripheral cannula; draw the blood count, clotting and thrombophilia antibody samples at the same time — before the first heparin dose, without delaying it.

response.zh-CN: 留置针已置入，血标本已抽取。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步，也没有记录采样与肝素的先后；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The cannula is in and the blood samples have been taken. This case does not record whether this was done or when the samples were taken relative to the heparin; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 低分子肝素治疗剂量皮下注射

dose.zh-CN: 依诺肝素 1 mg/kg 皮下注射，每 12 小时一次（或其他低分子肝素的等效治疗剂量）；肌酐清除率 < 30 mL/min 时调整；血小板 ≥ 50×10⁹/L 时用全量，每天复查血小板。
dose.en: Enoxaparin 1 mg/kg SC every 12 hours (or the equivalent treatment dose of another LMWH); adjust if creatinine clearance is < 30 mL/min; full dose while platelets are ≥ 50 × 10⁹/L, with a daily platelet count.

harm.zh-CN: 普通肝素已经在静脉泵入，再加低分子肝素就是两种抗凝药叠加，出血风险明显增加，何况她痰里还带血。要换药，先停普通肝素，不能叠加。
harm.en: An unfractionated heparin infusion is already running: adding LMWH stacks two anticoagulants and sharply raises the bleeding risk, with blood already in her sputum. To change drugs, stop the infusion first; never stack them.

response.zh-CN: 已皮下注射。本病例记录的抗凝从肝素开始（中文记录写明为低分子肝素），没有记录剂量、给药时间和抗Xa水平；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Given. This case records that anticoagulation began with heparin (low-molecular-weight heparin in the Chinese text) but not the dose, the timing or any anti-Xa level; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 普通肝素静脉推注后泵入（抗Xa监测）
name.en: Unfractionated heparin bolus and infusion (anti-Xa monitored)

dose.zh-CN: 普通肝素 80 U/kg 静脉推注，随后 18 U/kg/h 持续泵入；基线 APTT 已延长时按抗Xa活性（目标 0.3–0.7 IU/mL）而不是按 APTT 调整；每天复查血小板。
dose.en: UFH 80 U/kg IV bolus, then 18 U/kg/h by infusion; when the baseline APTT is already prolonged, adjust to anti-Xa activity (target 0.3–0.7 IU/mL), not the APTT; a daily platelet count.

harm.zh-CN: 已经注射了治疗剂量低分子肝素，再加普通肝素就是两种抗凝药叠加，出血风险明显增加，何况她痰里还带血。
harm.en: Treatment-dose LMWH has already been given: adding UFH stacks two anticoagulants and sharply raises the bleeding risk, with blood already in her sputum.

response.zh-CN: 肝素已推注并开始泵入。对多数血流动力学稳定的肺栓塞，ESC 2019 和 AHA/ACC 2026 更推荐低分子肝素；普通肝素主要用于血流动力学不稳定、可能需要再灌注或严重肾功能不全的患者。本病例没有记录用过普通肝素；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Bolus given and the infusion started. For most haemodynamically stable PE, ESC 2019 and AHA/ACC 2026 prefer LMWH, keeping UFH mainly for instability, possible reperfusion or severe renal impairment. This case does not record UFH; it does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 华法林每天口服一次，按 INR 调整剂量，目标 INR 2.0–3.0（2.5）；与肝素重叠至少 5 天，直到 INR 达标；开始前先确认没有怀孕，之后定期查 INR。
dose.en: Warfarin orally once daily, dose-adjusted to an INR of 2.0–3.0 (target 2.5); overlap with heparin for at least 5 days and until the INR is in range; confirm she is not pregnant before starting, then regular INR checks.

harm.zh-CN: 还没有肝素覆盖：华法林要几天才起效，最初几天蛋白C先下降，单用反而可能短暂增加血栓风险。ESC 2019 要求与肝素重叠至少 5 天、直到 INR 达到 2.0–3.0。先开始低分子肝素。
harm.en: There is no heparin cover yet: warfarin takes days to work and, because protein C falls first, can briefly raise the clotting risk on its own. ESC 2019 requires overlap with heparin for at least 5 days and until the INR is 2.0–3.0. Start the LMWH first.

response.zh-CN: 已开始华法林，肝素继续重叠。本病例记录此后改用华法林，但没有记录剂量、目标 INR 或 INR 数值；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Warfarin started, with the heparin continuing alongside. This case records the later change to warfarin but not the dose, the INR target or any INR value; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 全身静脉溶栓（阿替普酶）

dose.zh-CN: 阿替普酶 100 mg 静脉输注 2 小时。

harm.zh-CN: 她血压 130/80 mmHg、没有休克，不属于高危肺栓塞。ESC 2019 不推荐对中危或低危肺栓塞常规全身溶栓（Ⅲ类）：出血包括颅内出血的风险超过获益，何况她以前血小板就低、痰里还带血。溶栓只在抗凝期间出现血流动力学失代偿时作为补救。
harm.en: At 130/80 mmHg and without shock she does not have high-risk PE. ESC 2019 recommends against routine systemic thrombolysis in intermediate- or low-risk PE (class III): the risk of bleeding, intracranial haemorrhage included, outweighs the benefit — all the more with her history of low platelets and blood in her sputum. Lysis is a rescue for haemodynamic decompensation on anticoagulation.

dose.zh-CN: 介入科经股静脉或颈内静脉置入可回收滤器。
dose.en: A retrievable filter placed by interventional radiology via the femoral or jugular vein.

harm.zh-CN: 滤器不能治疗已经在双肺动脉里的血栓，也不能代替抗凝。ESC 2019 不推荐常规放置下腔静脉滤器（Ⅲ类），只在有抗凝绝对禁忌或充分抗凝下仍复发时考虑；偶有痰中带血、既往血小板偏低，都不是抗凝的绝对禁忌。
harm.en: A filter does nothing for the clots already in both lungs and does not replace anticoagulation. ESC 2019 recommends against routine IVC filters (class III), keeping them for an absolute contraindication to anticoagulation or recurrence despite adequate treatment; occasional blood-streaked sputum and a history of low platelets are not absolute contraindications.

response.zh-CN: 介入科完成了滤器置入。

dose.zh-CN: 单采血小板 1 个治疗量静脉输注。
dose.en: One adult dose of apheresis platelets IV.

harm.zh-CN: 没有大出血，也没有需要覆盖的有创操作，输血小板没有指征，也不会“让抗凝更安全”：血小板 ≥ 50×10⁹/L 时可以用全量抗凝（ISTH SSC 2018，针对癌症相关血栓，此处借鉴）。
harm.en: With no major bleeding and no invasive procedure to cover, a platelet transfusion has no indication and does not make anticoagulation 'safer': full-dose anticoagulation is given at platelet counts ≥ 50 × 10⁹/L (ISTH SSC 2018, written for cancer-associated thrombosis and borrowed here).

dose.zh-CN: 泼尼松 1 mg/kg 每天一次口服（免疫性血小板减少症的常用起始剂量），数周内逐渐减停。
dose.en: Prednisone 1 mg/kg orally once daily (the usual starting dose in immune thrombocytopenia), tapered off over weeks.

response.zh-CN: 已开始口服激素。报告在抗凝的同时用了激素、以后逐渐停用，但没有记录药名和剂量。ASH 2019 对新诊断的成人免疫性血小板减少症、血小板 ≥ 30×10⁹/L 且无出血或仅有轻微皮肤黏膜出血者推荐观察而不是糖皮质激素；她的血小板减少由来已久，58×10⁹/L 且无明显出血，看不出用激素的理由，激素也不能治疗血栓。本病例不模拟其效果。
response.en: Steroid started. The report gave steroids alongside the anticoagulation and later tapered them off, without recording the drug or dose. ASH 2019 recommends observation rather than corticosteroids for adults with newly diagnosed immune thrombocytopenia and platelets ≥ 30 × 10⁹/L with no or only minor mucocutaneous bleeding; her low platelets are long-standing, and 58 × 10⁹/L without significant bleeding gives no reason for steroids, which do not treat clots. The case does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 利伐沙班 15 mg 每天两次口服，共 3 周，随后 20 mg 每天一次。
dose.en: Rivaroxaban 15 mg orally twice daily for 3 weeks, then 20 mg once daily.

harm.zh-CN: 在查清她血栓的原因之前——尤其是有抗磷脂综合征可能时——不应选直接口服抗凝药：ESC 2019 不推荐用于抗磷脂综合征（Ⅲ类），AHA/ACC 2026 对血栓性抗磷脂综合征首选华法林，EULAR 2019 明确利伐沙班不用于三阳性患者。一位有过死胎、以前血小板就低的年轻女性，要先把这个问题查清楚。
harm.en: Until the cause of her clots is known — above all when antiphospholipid syndrome is possible — a DOAC is the wrong choice: ESC 2019 recommends against NOACs in APS (class III), AHA/ACC 2026 prefers warfarin for thrombotic APS, and EULAR 2019 rules out rivaroxaban in triple-positive patients. A young woman with a stillbirth and low platelets in the past needs that answered first.

name.zh-CN: 复方口服避孕药（含雌激素）

dose.zh-CN: 炔雌醇与孕激素的复方片，每天一片。
dose.en: An ethinylestradiol–progestogen combined pill, one a day.

harm.zh-CN: 刚发生静脉血栓栓塞，含雌激素的避孕药会进一步增加血栓风险。ACR 2020 生殖健康指南强烈建议抗磷脂抗体阳性的女性不用复方雌孕激素避孕药，可改用宫内节育器或单纯孕激素口服片。
harm.en: After a venous thromboembolism, oestrogen adds further clotting risk. The ACR 2020 reproductive health guideline strongly recommends against combined oestrogen–progestin contraceptives in women with antiphospholipid antibodies; offer an intrauterine device or a progestogen-only pill instead.

dose.zh-CN: 说明华法林可能伤害胎儿：用可靠且不含雌激素的避孕方法（宫内节育器或单纯孕激素口服片）；计划怀孕前先找专科评估，一旦确认怀孕立即改为治疗剂量低分子肝素加小剂量阿司匹林。
dose.en: Explain that warfarin can harm a fetus: use reliable contraception without oestrogen (an intrauterine device or a progestogen-only pill); see the specialists before trying to conceive, and change to treatment-dose LMWH plus low-dose aspirin as soon as pregnancy is confirmed.

response.zh-CN: 已与她讨论并写入出院计划。本病例没有记录避孕或妊娠计划的讨论；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Discussed with her and written into the discharge plan. This case does not record any discussion of contraception or pregnancy planning; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 请血液科评估（需要时与风湿免疫科共同评估）：凝血异常和血栓的原因、血小板与出血风险、需要复查的检查，以及今后的妊娠计划。
dose.en: Ask haematology to review her (with rheumatology when the work-up calls for it): the cause of the clotting abnormality and the clots, the platelets and bleeding risk, the follow-up tests and future pregnancy planning.

response.zh-CN: 会诊已申请。本病例没有记录是否请过会诊；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Requested. This case does not record whether a specialist review took place; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 安排至少 12 周后的复查
name.en: Plan repeat tests at least 12 weeks later

dose.zh-CN: 至少 12 周后复查入院时异常的易栓相关检查：抗体要同时查 IgG 和 IgM 两种同型，狼疮抗凝物用两种方法检测；正在抗凝时，由实验室结合用药选择方法、解读结果。
dose.en: At least 12 weeks later, repeat whichever thrombophilia tests were abnormal on admission: antibodies with both IgG and IgM isotypes, and lupus anticoagulant by two methods; while she is anticoagulated, the laboratory chooses the method and interprets the result with the drug in mind.

response.zh-CN: 已写入随访计划。本病例没有记录任何复查结果；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Added to the follow-up plan. This case records no repeat result; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 肝素治疗期间每天复查血小板

dose.zh-CN: 肝素治疗最初几天每天查血小板并观察出血；血小板进一步下降时重新评估出血风险，并考虑肝素诱导的血小板减少症。
dose.en: A platelet count and a check for bleeding every day in the first days of heparin; a further fall prompts a fresh look at the bleeding risk and at heparin-induced thrombocytopenia.

response.zh-CN: 已写入医嘱。本病例没有记录住院期间的血小板数值；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Added to the orders. This case records no platelet counts during the admission; it does not simulate the effect.

dose.en: Oxygen by nasal cannula if SpO₂ is below 90 % (ESC 2019).

response.zh-CN: 已给氧。本病例没有记录她的血氧饱和度；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Oxygen on. This case records no oxygen saturation for her; it does not simulate the effect.

title.zh-CN: 听她讲这半个月的经过
title.en: Hear the story of the past two weeks

hint.zh-CN: 咳嗽、气短、胸痛和双腿的变化是怎样出现的？她过去的血液问题和怀孕经历里，有什么可能和现在有关？
hint.en: How did the cough, breathlessness, chest pain and the change in her legs come about? What in her past — her blood, her pregnancies — might bear on this?

guidance.en: Go to her bedside and let her tell it.

title.zh-CN: 为她查体：胸部、双腿和血压
title.en: Examine her chest and legs and take her blood pressure

hint.zh-CN: 哪些体征能帮你区分心脏、肺和血管的原因？双肺听诊正常能排除什么、不能排除什么？
hint.en: Which signs help you tell a cardiac, a lung and a vascular cause apart — and what can a normal chest examination not exclude?

guidance.zh-CN: 看一般情况，听诊双肺，检查双下肢，测血压。
guidance.en: Look at her, listen to her lungs, examine both legs and measure her blood pressure.

title.en: Order and read the first tests

hint.zh-CN: 哪项影像能回答你最主要的疑问？在选择任何治疗之前，哪些血液结果必须先看到？
hint.en: Which imaging answers your main question, and which blood results must you see before choosing any treatment?

guidance.zh-CN: 开出影像和血液检查，在床旁或护士站读结果。
guidance.en: Order the imaging and the blood tests, and read the results at the bedside or the nurses' station.

title.zh-CN: 判断结果的意义，开始当天的治疗
title.en: Work out what the results mean and start today's treatment

hint.zh-CN: 凝血时间延长，是否意味着她不会长血栓？血小板计数和痰中带血会怎样影响你今天的选择？用药之前，哪些标本应该先送？
hint.en: Does a long clotting time mean she cannot form clots? How do the platelet count and the blood in her sputum shape today's choice — and which samples should go before the first dose?

guidance.zh-CN: 在会诊板上回答决策 1 和 2，然后给予你选定的治疗。
guidance.en: Answer decisions 1 and 2 on the case board, then give the treatment you have chosen.

title.zh-CN: 解读进一步检查，规划长期治疗
title.en: Interpret the further results and plan long-term care

hint.zh-CN: 一次阳性的抗体结果能证明什么、不能证明什么？长期用哪种抗凝药、用多久？以后怀孕的可能，会改变计划里的哪些部分？
hint.en: What can one positive antibody result prove, and what can it not? Which anticoagulant, and for how long — and what does a future pregnancy change in the plan?

guidance.zh-CN: 读住院期间回报的结果，在会诊板上回答决策 3 到 5，并开始长期抗凝。
guidance.en: Read the results reported during the admission, answer decisions 3 to 5 on the case board and start the long-term anticoagulant.

title.zh-CN: 对照她此后的实际经过
title.en: Compare your plan with what happened to her

hint.zh-CN: 报告中的治疗和你的方案哪里一致、哪里不同？3 个月时的结果能说明什么，又不能说明什么？
hint.en: Where did her treatment match your plan, and where did it differ? What does the 3-month result show, and what can it not show?

guidance.zh-CN: 在护士站调阅记录的治疗经过与结局。
guidance.en: Read the recorded treatment course and outcome at the nurses' station.

prompt.zh-CN: CT 显示双肺动脉及右下肺静脉充盈缺损，超声显示左侧股浅静脉和右侧腘静脉血栓。血小板 58×10⁹/L，APTT 71.6 s，INR 正常。她几年前被诊断为“特发性血小板减少”，曾有一次死胎。怎样解释延长的 APTT 最合适？
prompt.en: CT shows filling defects in both pulmonary arteries and the right inferior pulmonary vein; ultrasound shows thrombosis in the left superficial femoral and right popliteal veins. Platelets 58 × 10⁹/L, APTT 71.6 s, INR normal. She was told years ago that she had 'idiopathic thrombocytopenia', and she has had a stillbirth. Which explanation of the long APTT fits best?

need.zh-CN: 先读 CT、下肢静脉超声、血常规和凝血结果，并问清她以前的血小板问题和怀孕经历。
need.en: First read the CT, the leg ultrasound, the blood count and the clotting screen, and ask about her earlier platelet problem and her pregnancies.

text.zh-CN: 狼疮抗凝物样的体外现象：怀疑抗磷脂综合征，这是易栓而不是出血倾向，送检相关抗体
text.en: A lupus-anticoagulant-type laboratory effect: suspect antiphospholipid syndrome, a tendency to clot rather than bleed, and send the antibody tests

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。血栓患者单独延长的 APTT（INR 正常）最常见的原因是狼疮抗凝物：它在试管里干扰依赖磷脂的凝血反应，在体内却促发血栓；再加上血小板减少和一次死胎，抗磷脂综合征是首要考虑。ISTH SSC 2020 建议用两种方法（稀释蝰蛇毒时间和对狼疮抗凝物敏感的 APTT）检测，最好在开始抗凝前抽血，但不能因此推迟抗凝。
feedback.en: Correct. In a patient with clots, an isolated long APTT with a normal INR is most often a lupus anticoagulant: it slows phospholipid-dependent clotting in the tube while promoting thrombosis in the body, and with thrombocytopenia and a stillbirth, antiphospholipid syndrome leads the list. ISTH SSC 2020 advises two test systems (dilute Russell viper venom time and an LA-sensitive APTT), ideally sampled before anticoagulation — never at the cost of delaying it.

text.zh-CN: 内源性凝血因子（Ⅷ、Ⅸ或Ⅺ）缺乏或存在抑制物：她相当于已经自带抗凝，主要风险是出血
text.en: An intrinsic-pathway factor deficiency or inhibitor (factor VIII, IX or XI): she is in effect already anticoagulated, and bleeding is the main risk

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。凝血因子缺乏或获得性抑制物（如获得性血友病）确实能单独延长 APTT，但表现为出血，而她双肺和双下肢都有血栓。把延长的 APTT 当成“自带抗凝”而不抗凝，是这类患者最危险的错误。需要时用纠正试验（ISTH SSC 2020 的筛查—混合—确认流程）和因子活性测定来区分。
feedback.en: No. A factor deficiency or an acquired inhibitor (acquired haemophilia, say) can prolong the APTT on its own, but it causes bleeding — she has clots in both lungs and both legs. Treating a long APTT as built-in anticoagulation and withholding heparin is the most dangerous error in such a patient. A mixing study (part of the ISTH SSC 2020 screen–mix–confirm sequence) and factor assays separate the two when needed.

text.zh-CN: 弥散性血管内凝血：血栓消耗了血小板和凝血因子，应先寻找脓毒症或隐匿的肿瘤
text.en: Disseminated intravascular coagulation: the clots have used up platelets and clotting factors, so look first for sepsis or a hidden cancer

feedback.zh-CN: 不太可能。弥散性血管内凝血一般同时延长凝血酶原时间（INR 升高）并使纤维蛋白原下降，多见于重症感染或肿瘤；她 INR 正常，单独的 APTT 延长不符合消耗性凝血病。按 ISTH SSC 2020，有血栓的患者出现无法解释的 APTT 延长，是检测狼疮抗凝物的指征。
feedback.en: Unlikely. DIC usually prolongs the prothrombin time as well — the INR rises — with falling fibrinogen, typically in severe infection or cancer; her INR is normal, and an isolated long APTT does not fit consumption. Under ISTH SSC 2020, an unexplained long APTT in a patient with thrombosis is an indication for lupus anticoagulant testing.

text.zh-CN: 原有的免疫性血小板减少症加上一次偶然的无诱因血栓；APTT 延长只是采血误差，复查即可
text.en: Her old immune thrombocytopenia plus an unrelated, unprovoked clot; the long APTT is only a sampling error that needs repeating

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。免疫性血小板减少症不会延长 APTT，把 71.6 s 当作采血误差会丢掉关键线索。“特发性”血小板减少、死胎和血栓同时出现，应先排查抗磷脂综合征——2023 ACR/EULAR 分类标准把血小板减少（20–130×10⁹/L）列为临床领域之一。
feedback.en: No. Immune thrombocytopenia does not prolong the APTT, and calling 71.6 s a sampling error throws away the key clue. An 'idiopathic' thrombocytopenia, a stillbirth and a clot together call for antiphospholipid syndrome to be looked for — the 2023 ACR/EULAR criteria count thrombocytopenia (20–130 × 10⁹/L) as one of the clinical domains.

prompt.zh-CN: 她血压 130/80 mmHg，偶有痰中带血。CT 和超声证实双侧肺栓塞和下肢深静脉血栓；血小板 58×10⁹/L，APTT 71.6 s，INR 正常。今天开始什么治疗？
prompt.en: Her blood pressure is 130/80 mmHg and she has occasional blood-streaked sputum. CT and ultrasound confirm bilateral pulmonary embolism and deep-vein thrombosis; platelets 58 × 10⁹/L, APTT 71.6 s, INR normal. What do you start today?

need.zh-CN: 先作答决策 1（APTT 延长意味着什么）。
need.en: First answer decision 1 (what the long APTT means).

text.zh-CN: 今天开始按体重的治疗剂量低分子肝素（先抽好凝血和抗体标本），每天复查血小板，不溶栓
text.en: Weight-based treatment-dose LMWH today, after the clotting and antibody samples are drawn, with daily platelet counts and no lysis

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。肺栓塞确诊后应立即抗凝；对血流动力学稳定者，ESC 2019 推荐低分子肝素优于普通肝素（Ⅰ类），AHA/ACC 2026 同样首选低分子肝素。血小板 58×10⁹/L 且无大出血，不妨碍全量抗凝（ISTH SSC 2018 以 ≥ 50×10⁹/L 作为全量低分子肝素的界值，源自癌症相关血栓，此处借鉴）；偶有痰中带血要观察，但不是停用抗凝的理由。
feedback.en: Correct. Anticoagulate as soon as PE is confirmed; for haemodynamically stable patients ESC 2019 recommends LMWH over UFH (class I), as does AHA/ACC 2026. Platelets of 58 × 10⁹/L without major bleeding do not rule out a full dose (ISTH SSC 2018 uses ≥ 50 × 10⁹/L for full-dose LMWH in cancer-associated thrombosis, borrowed here); occasional blood-streaked sputum needs watching, not stopping.

text.zh-CN: 普通肝素静脉泵入，按 APTT 维持在实验室对照值的 1.5–2.5 倍来调整剂量，每天复查血小板
text.en: An unfractionated heparin infusion, dose-adjusted to keep the APTT at 1.5–2.5 times the laboratory control, with daily platelet counts

feedback.zh-CN: 不妥。用药前她的 APTT 已经是 71.6 s，按 APTT 调整会低估所需剂量、造成抗凝不足；如果确实需要普通肝素（例如可能要再灌注或严重肾功能不全），应按抗Xa活性监测。对血流动力学稳定的肺栓塞，ESC 2019 和 AHA/ACC 2026 都首选低分子肝素。
feedback.en: Not this way. Her APTT is 71.6 s before any heparin, so APTT-guided dosing under-treats her; if UFH is really needed (possible reperfusion, severe renal impairment), monitor it by anti-Xa activity. For stable PE, ESC 2019 and AHA/ACC 2026 both prefer LMWH.

text.zh-CN: 先用泼尼松 1 mg/kg 把血小板升上去，等血小板超过 100×10⁹/L 后再开始治疗剂量抗凝
text.en: Prednisone 1 mg/kg first to raise the platelets, and treatment-dose anticoagulation only once they are above 100 × 10⁹/L

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。推迟抗凝会让双肺和双下肢的血栓继续发展，激素也治不了血栓。ASH 2019 对新诊断的成人免疫性血小板减少症、血小板 ≥ 30×10⁹/L 且无明显出血者推荐观察而不是激素；血小板 ≥ 50×10⁹/L 时可以全量抗凝（ISTH SSC 2018，借鉴）。报告中的激素是与抗凝同时使用、以后逐渐停用的。
feedback.en: No. Delaying anticoagulation lets the clots in her lungs and legs extend, and steroids do not treat clots. ASH 2019 recommends observation, not corticosteroids, for adults with newly diagnosed immune thrombocytopenia and platelets ≥ 30 × 10⁹/L without significant bleeding, and full-dose anticoagulation is given at ≥ 50 × 10⁹/L (ISTH SSC 2018, borrowed). In the report, steroids were given at the same time as the anticoagulation and later tapered.

text.zh-CN: 全身静脉溶栓（阿替普酶 100 mg 2 小时），尽快清除双肺的血栓，然后接普通肝素泵入
text.en: Systemic alteplase 100 mg over 2 hours to clear the clots from both lungs quickly, then an unfractionated heparin infusion

feedback.zh-CN: 不对，而且危险。她血压 130/80 mmHg，不属于高危肺栓塞；ESC 2019 不推荐对中危或低危肺栓塞常规全身溶栓（Ⅲ类），血小板 58×10⁹/L 和痰中带血使出血风险更高。溶栓只在抗凝期间出现血流动力学失代偿时考虑。
feedback.en: No — and dangerous. At 130/80 mmHg she does not have high-risk PE; ESC 2019 recommends against routine systemic thrombolysis in intermediate- or low-risk PE (class III), and platelets of 58 × 10⁹/L with blood in her sputum raise the bleeding risk further. Lysis is for haemodynamic decompensation on anticoagulation.

text.zh-CN: 放置下腔静脉滤器，暂时不抗凝：她的 APTT 已经延长，血小板又低，抗凝出血风险太大
text.en: An inferior vena cava filter and no anticoagulant for now, since the APTT is already long and the platelets are low

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。延长的 APTT 不代表体内已经抗凝，血小板 58×10⁹/L 也不是抗凝的禁忌。滤器不能治疗肺动脉里的血栓，ESC 2019 不推荐常规使用（Ⅲ类），只在有抗凝绝对禁忌或充分抗凝下仍复发时考虑。不抗凝，血栓会继续发展。
feedback.en: No. A long APTT does not mean she is anticoagulated in the body, and 58 × 10⁹/L is not a contraindication. A filter does nothing for the clots in the lungs; ESC 2019 recommends against routine use (class III), keeping it for an absolute contraindication to anticoagulation or recurrence despite it. Without anticoagulation the clots extend.

prompt.zh-CN: 进一步检查回报：凝血因子Ⅷ、Ⅸ、Ⅺ活性无异常；ANA谱、ANCA、补体等未见异常；抗心磷脂抗体 104 U/mL（参考值 0–12），未注明同型；狼疮抗凝物和抗β2糖蛋白Ⅰ抗体没有结果。这些结果说明了什么？
prompt.en: Further results: factor VIII, IX and XI activity normal; ANA panel, ANCA and complement unremarkable; anticardiolipin 104 U/mL (reference 0–12), isotype not stated; no lupus anticoagulant or anti-β2-glycoprotein I result. What do these results establish?

need.zh-CN: 先读住院期间回报的凝血因子活性、自身抗体与补体，以及易栓相关抗体结果。
need.en: First read the clotting factor assays, the autoantibodies and complement, and the thrombophilia antibody tests reported during the admission.

text.zh-CN: 按抗磷脂综合征处理，但一次结果证明不了持续阳性：12 周后复查同型、抗β2GPI 和狼疮抗凝物
text.en: Treat it as antiphospholipid syndrome, but one result cannot show persistence: repeat with isotypes, anti-β2GPI and LA at ≥ 12 weeks

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。因子活性正常排除了因子缺乏；ANA谱和补体正常，目前没有系统性红斑狼疮的证据（以后仍要随访）。2023 ACR/EULAR 分类标准的实验室领域只计持续阳性（间隔至少 12 周），IgG 计分高于 IgM；一次、同型不明的抗心磷脂抗体还不能完成分类。分类标准是研究工具，不能代替临床诊断：现在就按抗磷脂综合征治疗。
feedback.en: Correct. Normal factor activity rules out a deficiency, and a normal ANA panel and complement give no evidence of lupus for now (keep watching). The 2023 ACR/EULAR criteria score the laboratory domains only for persistent positivity (≥ 12 weeks apart), with IgG scoring higher than IgM; one anticardiolipin of unstated isotype cannot complete classification. Classification criteria are research tools, not a substitute for diagnosis: treat as APS now.

text.zh-CN: 已经可以确诊：血栓再加上 104 U/mL 的抗心磷脂抗体就满足分类标准，不需要再查别的抗体了
text.en: Definite already: a clot plus an anticardiolipin of 104 U/mL meets the classification criteria, so no more antibody tests are needed

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。2023 ACR/EULAR 标准的实验室领域要求持续阳性（间隔至少 12 周），中、高滴度的界值（40–79 和 ≥ 80 单位）按标准化单位和同型（IgG 或 IgM）计分；一次、同型不明的 104 U/mL 不能代替复查。感染等情况也可能出现一过性阳性。
feedback.en: No. The 2023 ACR/EULAR laboratory domains need persistent positivity (≥ 12 weeks apart), and the moderate and high thresholds (40–79 and ≥ 80 units) are scored in standardised units by isotype (IgG or IgM); a single 104 U/mL of unknown isotype cannot replace a repeat. Infections, among other things, can cause transient positivity.

text.zh-CN: ANA谱、ANCA 和补体都正常，自身免疫性原因已经排除，抗心磷脂抗体的结果意义不大
text.en: With a normal ANA panel, ANCA and complement an autoimmune cause is excluded, and the anticardiolipin result means little

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。原发性抗磷脂综合征本来就不伴系统性红斑狼疮，ANA 阴性排除不了它；这些阴性结果只说明目前没有狼疮的证据。明显升高的抗心磷脂抗体，加上血栓、血小板减少和死胎，是需要确认而不是忽略的线索（2023 ACR/EULAR）。
feedback.en: No. Primary APS by definition occurs without lupus, so a negative ANA does not exclude it; these normal results show only that there is no evidence of lupus for now. A markedly raised anticardiolipin with clots, thrombocytopenia and a stillbirth is a lead to confirm, not to dismiss (2023 ACR/EULAR).

text.zh-CN: 先停用抗凝两周，等没有药物干扰时再测狼疮抗凝物，然后再决定诊断和治疗
text.en: Stop anticoagulation for two weeks so that lupus anticoagulant can be tested without drug interference, then decide

feedback.zh-CN: 不对，而且危险。急性肺栓塞后的几周内停用抗凝，复发风险会大大增加。ISTH SSC 2020 讨论了抗凝期间如何检测狼疮抗凝物（例如部分试剂含有肝素中和剂）；抗心磷脂抗体和抗β2GPI 的检测不受抗凝药影响。
feedback.en: No — and dangerous. Stopping anticoagulation in the weeks after an acute PE sharply raises the risk of recurrence. ISTH SSC 2020 discusses lupus anticoagulant testing on anticoagulants (some reagents contain heparin neutralisers), and anticardiolipin and anti-β2GPI assays are not affected by anticoagulants.

prompt.zh-CN: 她按抗磷脂综合征处理，抗体复查要等至少 12 周。长期抗凝怎么安排？
prompt.en: She is being treated as having antiphospholipid syndrome, and the repeat antibody tests are at least 12 weeks away. How do you plan her long-term anticoagulation?

need.zh-CN: 先作答决策 3（进一步检查说明了什么）。
need.en: First answer decision 3 (what the further results establish).

text.zh-CN: 华法林与肝素重叠 ≥ 5 天至 INR 2.0–3.0，之后维持 INR 2.0–3.0、不设停药期，不用直接口服抗凝药
text.en: Warfarin overlapping heparin for ≥ 5 days and until the INR is 2.0–3.0, then INR 2.0–3.0 with no planned stop; no DOAC

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。ESC 2019 推荐抗磷脂综合征患者无限期使用维生素K拮抗剂（Ⅰ类），并不推荐直接口服抗凝药（Ⅲ类）；EULAR 2019 对抗磷脂综合征首次无诱因静脉血栓推荐长期华法林、目标 INR 2–3（本例没有记录诱因）；AHA/ACC 2026 同样首选华法林。重叠按 ESC 2019：肝素至少 5 天、INR 达标后再停。12 周后的复查用来确认诊断和风险分层，不是停药的时间点。
feedback.en: Correct. ESC 2019 recommends indefinite VKA for APS (class I) and recommends against NOACs (class III); EULAR 2019 advises long-term warfarin, INR 2–3, after a first unprovoked venous thrombosis in APS (no provoking factor is recorded for her); AHA/ACC 2026 also prefers warfarin. Overlap per ESC 2019: heparin for at least 5 days and until the INR is in range. The 12-week repeat confirms the diagnosis and risk profile; it is not a stopping point.

text.zh-CN: 改为利伐沙班（15 mg 每天两次共 3 周，之后 20 mg 每天一次），这样她就不用反复抽血查 INR 了
text.en: Change to rivaroxaban (15 mg twice daily for 3 weeks, then 20 mg once daily) to spare her repeated INR blood tests

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。ESC 2019 不推荐在抗磷脂综合征中使用直接口服抗凝药（Ⅲ类）；EULAR 2019 明确利伐沙班不用于三阳性患者，而她的抗体谱还不完整，排除不了三阳性；AHA/ACC 2026 对血栓性抗磷脂综合征首选华法林。方便不能代替疗效。
feedback.en: No. ESC 2019 recommends against NOACs in APS (class III); EULAR 2019 rules out rivaroxaban in triple-positive patients, and her incomplete antibody profile cannot exclude triple positivity; AHA/ACC 2026 prefers warfarin for thrombotic APS. Convenience does not outweigh efficacy.

text.zh-CN: 华法林 INR 2.0–3.0 用满 3 个月，复查 CT 若血栓已经消失就停药，按首次肺栓塞的常规处理
text.en: Warfarin to an INR of 2.0–3.0 for 3 months, stopping if a repeat CT shows the clots have gone, as for a first PE

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。3 个月后停药适用于有重大可逆诱因的首次肺栓塞；ESC 2019 对抗磷脂综合征推荐无限期维生素K拮抗剂（Ⅰ类），因为停药后复发风险高。复查影像血栓消失，不代表易栓状态已经消失。
feedback.en: No. Stopping at 3 months fits a first PE with a major reversible risk factor; ESC 2019 recommends indefinite VKA in APS (class I) because recurrence after stopping is high. Clots gone on imaging do not mean the clotting tendency has gone.

text.zh-CN: 华法林把 INR 控制在 3.0–4.0，再加阿司匹林 100 mg 每天一次，因为双肺和双下肢同时都有血栓
text.en: Warfarin to an INR of 3.0–4.0 plus aspirin 100 mg daily, because the clots formed in both lungs and both legs at the same time

feedback.zh-CN: 不妥。EULAR 2019 对首次静脉血栓推荐 INR 2–3；INR 3–4 或加用阿司匹林用于动脉血栓或标准强度下仍复发的情况，而且会增加出血——她的血小板是 58×10⁹/L。血栓部位多，并不等于需要更高的强度。
feedback.en: Not this. EULAR 2019 advises an INR of 2–3 after a first venous thrombosis; INR 3–4 or added aspirin is for arterial events or recurrence on standard intensity, and it adds bleeding — her platelets were 58 × 10⁹/L. More clot sites do not call for higher intensity.

prompt.zh-CN: 出院前她问：“我以后还能要孩子吗？”她就要开始长期服用华法林。你怎么建议、怎么安排？
prompt.en: Before discharge she asks, 'Will I still be able to have a baby?' She is about to start long-term warfarin. What do you advise and arrange?

need.zh-CN: 先作答决策 4（长期抗凝方案）。
need.en: First answer decision 4 (the long-term anticoagulation plan).

text.zh-CN: 先查妊娠试验，避孕不用雌激素；与专科计划怀孕，确认怀孕后改用低分子肝素加阿司匹林
text.en: Pregnancy test first, no oestrogen contraception, and pregnancy planned with specialists: LMWH plus aspirin once she conceives

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。华法林可能伤害胎儿：开始前确认没有怀孕，服药期间可靠避孕；ACR 2020 生殖健康指南强烈建议抗磷脂抗体阳性女性不用复方雌孕激素避孕药，可用宫内节育器或单纯孕激素口服片。EULAR 2019 对血栓性抗磷脂综合征的妊娠推荐小剂量阿司匹林加治疗剂量肝素；确认妊娠后应尽快把华法林换成低分子肝素。她可以怀孕，但要有计划、有专科随访。
feedback.en: Correct. Warfarin can harm a fetus: exclude pregnancy before starting and use reliable contraception while on it; the ACR 2020 reproductive health guideline strongly recommends against combined oestrogen–progestin contraceptives in women with antiphospholipid antibodies, an intrauterine device or a progestogen-only pill can be used instead. EULAR 2019 recommends low-dose aspirin plus treatment-dose heparin in pregnancy for thrombotic APS, and warfarin is changed to LMWH as soon as pregnancy is confirmed. Pregnancy is possible — planned, with specialist care.

text.zh-CN: 华法林能防血栓，所以现在吃复方避孕药没有问题；等想要孩子时，停掉华法林就可以开始备孕
text.en: Warfarin protects her from clots, so the combined pill is fine for now; when she wants a baby she simply stops the warfarin and tries

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。含雌激素的避孕药增加血栓风险，ACR 2020 强烈建议抗磷脂抗体阳性女性不用；停掉华法林而不换成肝素，她在血栓风险更高的孕期就失去了保护（EULAR 2019：治疗剂量肝素加小剂量阿司匹林）。
feedback.en: No. Oestrogen raises the clotting risk, and ACR 2020 strongly recommends against it in women with antiphospholipid antibodies; stopping warfarin without heparin leaves her unprotected through pregnancy, when the risk is higher still (EULAR 2019: treatment-dose heparin plus low-dose aspirin).

text.zh-CN: 怀孕后整个孕期都继续服用华法林，因为它对这种病最有效，从一开始就再加用小剂量阿司匹林
text.en: Continue warfarin through any pregnancy, since it is the most effective drug for her condition, adding low-dose aspirin from the start

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。华法林能通过胎盘，孕早期可致胚胎病，之后还有胎儿出血的风险；确认妊娠后应改为低分子肝素（EULAR 2019 对血栓性抗磷脂综合征：治疗剂量肝素加小剂量阿司匹林）。
feedback.en: No. Warfarin crosses the placenta: it can cause embryopathy early in pregnancy and fetal bleeding later; once pregnancy is confirmed, change to LMWH (EULAR 2019 for thrombotic APS: treatment-dose heparin plus low-dose aspirin).

text.zh-CN: 计划怀孕时就停用抗凝药，整个孕期只吃小剂量阿司匹林，这样对胎儿更温和、也更安全
text.en: When she plans a pregnancy, stop the anticoagulant and take low-dose aspirin alone throughout, which is gentler on the baby

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。她有深静脉血栓和肺栓塞，属于血栓性抗磷脂综合征，单用阿司匹林不够；EULAR 2019 对血栓性抗磷脂综合征的妊娠推荐治疗剂量肝素加小剂量阿司匹林，只有单纯产科抗磷脂综合征才用预防剂量肝素加阿司匹林。
feedback.en: No. With DVT and PE she has thrombotic APS, for which aspirin alone is not enough; EULAR 2019 recommends treatment-dose heparin plus low-dose aspirin in pregnancy for thrombotic APS — prophylactic heparin with aspirin is for obstetric-only APS.

text.zh-CN: 问清了咳嗽和少量白痰、偶有的痰中血丝、活动后气短、胸痛的性质、半个月病程和近三天加重，以及双腿先胀痛后水肿
text.en: Took the presenting story: cough with a little white phlegm, occasional streaks of blood, breathlessness on exertion, the character of the chest pain, two weeks' course worse for three days, and legs that ached and then swelled

text.zh-CN: 问了既往血小板减少及其治疗、死胎与那次妊娠的并发症、出血史、既往血栓、手术与近期制动，以及现在是否可能怀孕和避孕情况（未记录的回答本身就是需要处理的空白）
text.en: Asked about the earlier low platelets and their treatment, the stillbirth and that pregnancy's complications, bleeding, earlier clots, surgery and recent immobility, and possible pregnancy and contraception now (the unrecorded answers are gaps to act on)

text.zh-CN: 看了口唇颜色，听诊双肺，检查双下肢水肿，并测了血压
text.en: Looked at her colour, listened to her lungs, examined both legs for oedema and measured her blood pressure

text.zh-CN: 读了CT、下肢静脉超声、血常规和凝血结果，送检了易栓相关抗体和肾功能，并申请超声心动图或肌钙蛋白、利钠肽评估右心
text.en: Read the CT, leg ultrasound, blood count and clotting screen, sent the thrombophilia antibody tests and renal function, and asked for an echocardiogram or troponin and natriuretic peptide to assess the right heart

text.zh-CN: 第一次作答就把延长的 APTT 认作易栓而非出血的线索
text.en: Read the long APTT as a sign of a clotting, not a bleeding, tendency at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 入院当天、看过血小板计数后即开始治疗剂量抗凝（低分子肝素，或按抗Xa监测的普通肝素）
text.en: Started treatment-dose anticoagulation on the day of admission once the platelet count was known (LMWH, or anti-Xa-monitored UFH)

text.zh-CN: 第一次作答就选对当天的治疗，并安排肝素期间每天复查血小板
text.en: Chose the first day's treatment correctly at the first attempt and set up daily platelet counts on heparin

text.zh-CN: 没有给这位血压正常、血小板减少的患者溶栓
text.en: Gave no thrombolysis to a normotensive patient with a low platelet count

text.zh-CN: 避开了其他有害做法：不放滤器、不输血小板、不用直接口服抗凝药、不在没有肝素覆盖或未查妊娠试验时用华法林、不叠加两种肝素、不开含雌激素的避孕药
text.en: Avoided the other harmful steps: no filter, no platelet transfusion, no DOAC, no warfarin without heparin cover or a pregnancy test, no stacking of two heparins and no oestrogen-containing contraceptive

text.zh-CN: 读了凝血因子、自身抗体与补体和易栓相关抗体结果，第一次作答就判断对它们能说明和不能说明的内容，并安排 12 周后复查
text.en: Read the factor assays, autoantibodies and complement and the thrombophilia antibody results, judged what they do and do not establish at the first attempt, and planned the 12-week repeat

text.zh-CN: 第一次作答就定好长期抗凝和生育安排，在肝素覆盖下、送检妊娠试验后开始华法林，完成避孕与妊娠计划咨询并请专科会诊
text.en: Planned long-term anticoagulation and family planning correctly at the first attempt, started warfarin under heparin cover after sending a pregnancy test, gave contraception and pregnancy-planning advice and asked for a specialist review

text.zh-CN: 用她听得懂的话解释血栓、长期抗凝和今后怀孕的安排，回应她对血痰和生育的担心，并确认她听懂了
text.en: Explained the clots, long-term anticoagulation and future pregnancy in words she understands, answered her worries about the blood in her sputum and about having a baby, and checked her understanding

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: Calgary–Cambridge 的解释与计划环节。好的表现：先问她已经知道什么、最担心什么；用日常语言说明肺里和双腿都有血栓，痰里的血丝和胸痛与此有关；说明化验里“凝血慢”其实提示更容易长血栓，这就是为什么今天就要打抗凝针；坦率说明诊断目前是“工作诊断”，要在至少 12 周后复查抗体才能确认，不夸大也不轻描淡写；解释改用华法林后要定期抽血查 INR、留意出血、注意药物和饮食的相互影响，以及为什么不换成“不用抽血”的新药；谈到死胎时承认她的伤痛，说明那次经历可能与这个病有关，但具体情况还不清楚；关于生育：华法林可能伤害胎儿，现在要用不含雌激素的可靠避孕，想怀孕前先来计划，一旦怀孕要立即改为打针加小剂量阿司匹林——她可以怀孕，但要有计划；最后请她用自己的话复述要点（teach-back），并给出复诊和出现胸痛加重、气促加重、咯血增多、黑便或其他出血时立即就医的安排。不应出现的：虚假的保证，“血小板低所以不能抗凝”之类的错误说法，或回避她的生育问题。
judgeGuidance.en: Calgary–Cambridge explanation and planning. Good performance: start by finding out what she already knows and what she fears most; explain in everyday words that there are clots in her lungs and both legs, and that the streaks of blood and the chest pain fit with them; explain that the 'slow clotting' blood test actually points to a tendency to clot, which is why the injections start today; say frankly that the diagnosis is a working one that needs repeat antibody tests at least 12 weeks later — neither overstated nor played down; explain warfarin: regular INR blood tests, watching for bleeding, interactions with other medicines and food, and why she is not switched to a 'no-blood-test' tablet; acknowledge her loss when the stillbirth comes up, and that it may be linked to this condition though the details are unknown; on a future pregnancy: warfarin can harm a baby, so reliable contraception without oestrogen now, a planning visit before trying, and a change to injections plus low-dose aspirin as soon as she is pregnant — pregnancy is possible, with planning; finish with teach-back and safety-netting (return at once with worse chest pain or breathlessness, more blood in the sputum, black stools or other bleeding) and a follow-up appointment. Not acceptable: false reassurance, 'your platelets are too low for blood thinners', or avoiding her question about a baby.

name.zh-CN: 温医生（呼吸与危重症医学科主治医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教，最后按 PEARLS 复盘；只就学员已经得到的信息提问，从不先给结果或诊断。决策 1 之前：“年轻女性活动后气短、痰中带血、胸痛、两条腿肿——你最担心什么？靠什么确认？”“双肺听诊正常能排除什么？”“用任何抗凝药之前，哪些血液结果必须先看到？”学员读过凝血结果之后：“一个可能正在长血栓的人，凝血检查却是这样的结果——怎么解释？”“她以前的血小板诊断和那次死胎，和现在有什么联系？”决策 1 之后：“首剂肝素前要送哪些标本？为什么不等结果再抗凝？”“这里为什么用低分子肝素而不是普通肝素？万一要用普通肝素，怎么监测？”“血小板到多少你会调整剂量？”“为什么不溶栓？”住院期间、学员读过进一步检查之后：“这个抗体结果能说明什么？要完成分类还缺什么？”“为什么用华法林，用多久？”“对可能还想要孩子的她，华法林意味着什么？”看过结局后讨论当年与现在：与抗凝同时使用的激素、3 个月时的CT、抗体只查过一次。清楚哪些内容没有记录（心率、呼吸、血氧饱和度、体温、右心室情况、肌钙蛋白、体重、肾功能、死胎孕周、采样是否在肝素之前、所有剂量，以及学员读到结果后才谈的后续检查细节）；遇到这些就直说没有记录，不替病例补全。
knowledge.en: Socratic teacher who closes with a PEARLS debrief; asks only about what the learner already has and never gives a result or the diagnosis first. Before decision 1: 'A young woman, breathless on exertion, blood in her sputum, chest pain and two swollen legs — what worries you, and what will confirm it?' 'What does a clear chest examination rule out?' 'Which blood results must you see before any anticoagulant?' Once the learner has read the clotting screen: 'How do you explain this clotting result in someone who may be forming clots?' 'What links her old platelet diagnosis and her stillbirth to this?' After decision 1: 'Which samples go before the first heparin dose, and why not wait for their results?' 'Why LMWH rather than UFH here, and how would you monitor UFH if you had to use it?' 'At what platelet count would you change the dose?' 'Why not thrombolysis?' During the admission, once the further results are read: 'What does that antibody result establish, and what is still missing for classification?' 'Why warfarin, and for how long?' 'What does warfarin mean for a woman who may want a baby?' After the outcome, then versus now: steroids given alongside the heparin, a CT at three months, antibodies tested once. Knows what is not recorded — her pulse, respiratory rate, saturation and temperature, the right ventricle, troponin, weight, renal function, the stillbirth's gestation, whether the samples preceded the heparin, every dose, and the details of the later tests, which it discusses only once the learner has read them — and says so rather than filling the gap.

knowledge.zh-CN: 收她入院的病房护士。ISBAR 交班：谢予宁，30岁，今天因咳嗽、活动后气短伴胸痛半个月、近三天加重入院；偶有痰中带血；两条腿胀痛、肿胀；血压 130/80 mmHg，其他生命体征我这里没有；请您来看看。床旁有治疗车（留置针、采血管）、病房备用药和氧气；妊娠试验的尿标本在床旁留取；CT 在影像科，要由护工和护士陪同推过去；超声和心脏超声的机器可以推到床旁。每条医嘱都复述药名、剂量和途径；按体重给药前会问体重（病历上没有）；结果回来才报告，从不解读，也不说诊断。
knowledge.en: The ward nurse admitting her. ISBAR handover: Xie Yuning, 30, admitted today with two weeks of cough, breathlessness on exertion and chest pain, worse for three days; occasional blood-streaked sputum; both legs aching and swollen; blood pressure 130/80 mmHg, and I have no other observations to hand over; please come and see her. At the bedside: the treatment cart (cannula, sample tubes), ward stock medicines and oxygen; urine for a pregnancy test is collected at the bedside; the CT scanner is in imaging and she goes there with a porter and a nurse; the ultrasound and echo machines can come to the bed. Reads every order back with drug, dose and route; asks for her weight before a weight-based dose (it is not on her chart); reports a result only once it is back, and never interprets it or names a diagnosis.

knowledge.zh-CN: 只解读学员已经读过的影像报告。CT 上肺动脉内的充盈缺损提示肺栓塞，两侧都有即为双侧；若报告提到肺静脉内充盈缺损，要知道这很少见——血栓是一种解释，血流伪影和肿瘤也可以类似，需要回看图像复核，而真正的肺静脉血栓回流向左心房。报告没有给出右心室大小或右/左心室比值时，就直说没有。下肢超声：股浅静脉虽然名字里有“浅”，其实是深静脉，它和腘静脉的血栓都属于近端深静脉血栓。不解读不存在的检查（本病例没有超声心动图、心电图或胸片结果），也不说出潜在的综合征。
knowledge.en: Interprets only the imaging reports the learner has read. Filling defects in the pulmonary arteries on CT mean pulmonary embolism, bilateral when both sides are involved; if a report describes a filling defect in a pulmonary vein, that is unusual — thrombus is one explanation, but flow artefact and tumour can mimic it, so the images deserve a second look, and a true pulmonary-vein thrombus drains towards the left atrium. When a report gives no right-ventricular size or RV/LV ratio, says so. Leg ultrasound: despite its name the superficial femoral vein is a deep vein, so thrombus there or in the popliteal vein is proximal deep-vein thrombosis. Does not interpret studies that do not exist (there is no echocardiogram, ECG or chest X-ray result) and does not name the underlying syndrome.

knowledge.zh-CN: 只解读学员已经读过的血液结果。狼疮抗凝物在体外延长 APTT 等依赖磷脂的检测，在体内却增加血栓风险；纠正试验和因子活性测定可以把它与因子缺乏或抑制物区分开（本病例没有纠正试验、凝血酶原时间和纤维蛋白原结果）。剂量：按体重的低分子肝素需要体重和肌酐清除率，两者都没有记录；基线 APTT 已延长时，普通肝素要按抗Xa监测。血小板：≥ 50×10⁹/L 可用全量低分子肝素（ISTH SSC 2018，癌症相关血栓，借鉴），每天复查，进一步下降时要考虑出血和肝素诱导的血小板减少症。抗体：一次抗心磷脂抗体结果，无论多高，都需要同型、抗β2GPI、两种方法的狼疮抗凝物和至少 12 周后的复查；肝素或华法林期间检测狼疮抗凝物要听实验室意见（ISTH SSC 2020）。长期：华法林，INR 2.0–3.0，不用直接口服抗凝药。学员作答前不说出诊断。
knowledge.en: Interprets only the blood results the learner has read. A lupus anticoagulant prolongs phospholipid-dependent tests such as the APTT in vitro while raising thrombotic risk in vivo; a mixing study and factor assays separate it from a factor deficiency or inhibitor (no mixing study, prothrombin time or fibrinogen is recorded here). Dosing: weight-based LMWH needs her weight and creatinine clearance, neither recorded; when the baseline APTT is prolonged, UFH needs anti-Xa monitoring. Platelets: full-dose LMWH at ≥ 50 × 10⁹/L (ISTH SSC 2018, cancer-associated thrombosis, borrowed), daily counts, and a further fall raises bleeding and heparin-induced thrombocytopenia questions. Antibodies: one anticardiolipin result, however high, needs the isotype, anti-β2GPI, a lupus anticoagulant by two methods and a repeat at least 12 weeks later; lupus anticoagulant testing on heparin or warfarin needs the laboratory's advice (ISTH SSC 2020). Long term: warfarin to an INR of 2.0–3.0, not a DOAC. Does not name the diagnosis before the learner commits.

knowledge.zh-CN: 只解读学员已经读过的自身抗体、补体和易栓相关抗体结果。2023 ACR/EULAR 分类标准用于研究队列，不是诊断清单：实验室领域要求持续阳性，IgG 计分高于 IgM，产科事件按孕周计分——她死胎时的孕周、有无子痫前期或胎盘功能不全都没有记录。ANA谱和补体正常时，目前不太像系统性红斑狼疮，但不是永远排除，随访时要留意狼疮的表现。妊娠：要提前计划；对血栓性抗磷脂综合征，EULAR 2019 推荐孕期治疗剂量肝素加小剂量阿司匹林，确认妊娠后尽快从华法林换过来；避孕不用含雌激素的方法（ACR 2020）。学员作答前不说出诊断，也不解读结局记录。
knowledge.en: Interprets only the autoantibody, complement and thrombophilia antibody results the learner has read. The 2023 ACR/EULAR classification criteria are for research cohorts, not a diagnostic checklist: they need persistent laboratory positivity, score IgG above IgM and score obstetric events by gestation — the gestation of her stillbirth and any pre-eclampsia or placental insufficiency are not recorded. When the ANA panel and complement are normal, lupus is unlikely for now, not for ever: look for lupus features at follow-up. Pregnancy: plan ahead; for thrombotic APS, EULAR 2019 recommends treatment-dose heparin plus low-dose aspirin through pregnancy, changing from warfarin as soon as pregnancy is confirmed; contraception without oestrogen (ACR 2020). Does not name the diagnosis before the learner commits and never interprets the outcome record.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：以双侧肺栓塞和下肢深静脉血栓起病的抗磷脂综合征
title.en: Debrief: antiphospholipid syndrome presenting with bilateral pulmonary embolism and leg deep-vein thrombosis

conclusion.zh-CN: 抗磷脂综合征（报告诊断为原发性）以双侧肺栓塞和近端深静脉血栓起病。30岁女性，咳嗽、少量白痰偶带血丝、活动后气短伴间断钝性胸痛半个月，近3天加重，双下肢胀痛、可凹性水肿；血压 130/80 mmHg。CT 示双肺动脉及右下肺静脉充盈缺损，超声示左股浅静脉和右腘静脉血栓；血小板 58×10⁹/L，APTT 71.6 s，INR 正常，D-二聚体 902 μg/L；凝血因子Ⅷ、Ⅸ、Ⅺ正常，ANA谱、ANCA、补体未见异常；抗心磷脂抗体 104 U/mL（参考 0–12），只有一次记录、同型未注明。既往“特发性血小板减少”，曾有一次死胎。报告先用肝素（中文记录为低分子肝素）后改华法林，同时使用激素并逐渐停用；3 个月CT示血栓消失，血小板改善，没有复发的报告。现行做法：确诊当天即用低分子肝素、不溶栓；至少 12 周后复查抗体；华法林 INR 2–3 长期抗凝，不用直接口服抗凝药（ESC 2019；EULAR 2019；AHA/ACC 2026）。
conclusion.en: Antiphospholipid syndrome (primary, per the report) presenting with bilateral PE and proximal DVT. A 30-year-old woman had two weeks of cough with scant white, sometimes blood-streaked sputum, exertional breathlessness and intermittent dull chest pain, worse for three days, and aching legs with pitting oedema; BP 130/80 mmHg. CT: filling defects in both pulmonary arteries and the right inferior pulmonary vein; ultrasound: left superficial femoral and right popliteal vein thrombosis. Platelets 58 × 10⁹/L, APTT 71.6 s, INR normal, D-dimer 902 µg/L; factors VIII, IX, XI normal; ANA panel, ANCA, complement unremarkable; anticardiolipin 104 U/mL (reference 0–12), one recorded result. Past 'idiopathic thrombocytopenia'; one stillbirth. Heparin then warfarin, steroids tapered; clots gone on CT at 3 months, platelets improved, no recurrence reported. Today: LMWH on day one, no lysis, antibodies repeated at ≥ 12 weeks, indefinite warfarin (INR 2–3), no DOAC (ESC 2019; EULAR 2019; AHA/ACC 2026).

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 年轻女性活动后气短、痰中带血、胸痛，加上双腿胀痛水肿，在任何检查之前就应考虑静脉血栓栓塞；双肺听诊清、无发绀并不能否定它。
keyReasoning.en: Exertional breathlessness, blood-streaked sputum, chest pain and two aching, swollen legs in a young woman point to venous thromboembolism before any test; clear lungs and no cyanosis do not argue against it.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 正在长血栓的患者 APTT 延长而 INR 正常，是实验室与临床的矛盾，提示狼疮抗凝物，而不是“不会长血栓”；后来正常的因子Ⅷ、Ⅸ、Ⅺ也支持这一点。
keyReasoning.en: A long APTT with a normal INR in a patient who is clotting is a paradox between laboratory and bedside that points to a lupus anticoagulant, not to protection from thrombosis; the normal factors VIII, IX and XI later fit that reading.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 曾被称为“特发性”的血小板减少、一次死胎和静脉血栓，可能是同一个综合征的三条线索；把它们连起来，肺栓塞的检查就转向了抗磷脂综合征。
keyReasoning.en: A thrombocytopenia once labelled idiopathic, a stillbirth and venous thrombosis may be three threads of one syndrome; tying them together turns a PE work-up into an APS work-up.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 第一天最大的危险是不作为：血压正常时，血小板和少量痰中带血决定的是用什么药、怎么监测，而不是要不要抗凝；溶栓只会徒增风险。
keyReasoning.en: The first-day danger is inaction: in a normotensive patient, the platelet count and minor haemoptysis shape the drug and the monitoring, not whether to anticoagulate — and thrombolysis would add risk without benefit.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 一次超出参考范围的抗体结果支持诊断，但证明不了持续阳性，也定不了风险分层；计划是现在就治疗，12 周后再确认。
keyReasoning.en: One antibody result above the laboratory range supports the diagnosis but proves neither persistence nor the risk profile; the plan treats now and confirms at 12 weeks.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 长期用药跟着诊断走，而不是图方便——用华法林而不是直接口服抗凝药；华法林对胎儿的影响，让避孕和妊娠计划成为处方的一部分。
keyReasoning.en: The long-term drug follows the diagnosis, not convenience — warfarin, not a DOAC — and warfarin's effect on a pregnancy makes contraception and pregnancy planning part of the prescription.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是 2013 年发表的单例报告，不能证明激素提升了血小板或任何方案能预防复发，也没有说明随访有多长。本病例只有一次抗心磷脂抗体结果，没有狼疮抗凝物和抗β2GPI；病例中的决策、干预选项和评分是教学设计，不改变已发表的病程。患者事实沿用 1.0.0 版的提取内容，尚未对照原文全文核对。
boundaries.en: A single report published in 2013: it cannot show that the steroids raised the platelets or that any regimen prevents recurrence, and it does not say how long follow-up lasted. The case records one anticardiolipin result and no lupus anticoagulant or anti-β2GPI; its decisions, intervention options and scoring are teaching design and do not change the published course. The patient facts are those extracted for version 1.0.0 and have not yet been checked against the full article.

unknowns.zh-CN: 抗体谱：抗心磷脂抗体的同型（IgG 或 IgM）和检测单位，狼疮抗凝物、抗β2糖蛋白Ⅰ抗体，以及间隔至少 12 周的复查。

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 狼疮抗凝物：试管里凝血慢，体内却易栓。ISTH SSC 2020：用两种方法（稀释蝰蛇毒时间和对狼疮抗凝物敏感的 APTT），按筛查、混合、确认的步骤检测，最好在抗凝前采血，因为肝素和维生素K拮抗剂会干扰结果——但绝不为采血推迟治疗；抗心磷脂抗体和抗β2GPI 的免疫检测不受影响。当年与现在：本病例只记录了 APTT 71.6 s 和正常的 INR，没有纠正试验和狼疮抗凝物结果。
teachingPoints.en: Lupus anticoagulant: a clotting test that runs slow in the tube, a patient who clots. ISTH SSC 2020: test with two systems (dilute Russell viper venom time and an LA-sensitive APTT) by screen, mix and confirm, ideally before anticoagulation because heparin and vitamin K antagonists interfere — but never delay treatment for the sample; anticardiolipin and anti-β2GPI immunoassays are unaffected. Then and now: this case records only the APTT of 71.6 s with a normal INR — no mixing study and no lupus anticoagulant result.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 确诊当天就抗凝。ESC 2019：肺栓塞确诊后立即抗凝；初始胃肠外抗凝首选低分子肝素而非普通肝素（Ⅰ类，AHA/ACC 2026 相同）；中危或低危肺栓塞不常规全身溶栓（Ⅲ类）——她血压 130/80 mmHg；下腔静脉滤器只用于抗凝绝对禁忌（常规使用为Ⅲ类）。ISTH SSC 2018（针对癌症相关血栓）以 ≥ 50×10⁹/L 作为全量低分子肝素的界值：血小板 58×10⁹/L 时用全量并每天复查。如需普通肝素，按抗Xa监测——被狼疮抗凝物延长的基线 APTT 无法指导剂量。
teachingPoints.en: Anticoagulate on day one. ESC 2019: anticoagulation without delay once PE is confirmed; LMWH rather than UFH for initial parenteral treatment (class I; AHA/ACC 2026 likewise); no routine systemic thrombolysis in intermediate- or low-risk PE (class III) — her BP was 130/80 mmHg; IVC filters only for an absolute contraindication to anticoagulation (routine use class III). ISTH SSC 2018, for cancer-associated thrombosis, sets ≥ 50 × 10⁹/L for full-dose LMWH: at 58 × 10⁹/L, the full dose with daily counts. If UFH is needed, monitor anti-Xa — a baseline APTT prolonged by a lupus anticoagulant cannot guide the dose.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 分类不等于诊断。2023 ACR/EULAR 抗磷脂综合征分类标准：先满足入选条件（临床事件前后 3 年内至少一次抗磷脂抗体阳性），再在临床和实验室领域各得至少 3 分；抗心磷脂抗体/抗β2GPI 只按持续的中、高滴度阳性计分（间隔至少 12 周；中滴度 40–79、高滴度 ≥ 80 单位），IgG 计分高于 IgM；狼疮抗凝物一次阳性计 1 分、持续阳性计 5 分；血小板 20–130×10⁹/L 属于临床领域，产科事件按孕周计分——本例孕周没有记录。当年与现在：报告的“原发性抗磷脂综合征”只依据一次同型未注明的抗心磷脂抗体（104 U/mL，参考 0–12）；今天的做法是按抗磷脂综合征治疗，同时确认持续阳性。
teachingPoints.en: Classification is not diagnosis. 2023 ACR/EULAR APS criteria: an entry criterion (a positive antiphospholipid test within 3 years of a clinical event), then at least 3 clinical and 3 laboratory points; anticardiolipin and anti-β2GPI score only for persistent moderate or high positivity (≥ 12 weeks apart; moderate 40–79, high ≥ 80 units), IgG more than IgM; a lupus anticoagulant positive once scores 1, persistently 5; thrombocytopenia of 20–130 × 10⁹/L counts in a clinical domain, and obstetric events score by gestation — not recorded here. Then and now: the report's 'primary APS' rests on one anticardiolipin of unstated isotype (104 U/mL, reference 0–12); today's answer is to treat as APS while confirming persistence.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 长期用华法林，不用直接口服抗凝药。ESC 2019：抗磷脂综合征无限期使用维生素K拮抗剂（Ⅰ类），不推荐直接口服抗凝药（Ⅲ类）；与胃肠外抗凝重叠至少 5 天、直到 INR 达 2.0–3.0。EULAR 2019：首次无诱因静脉血栓后长期用维生素K拮抗剂，目标 INR 2–3；三阳性患者不用利伐沙班。AHA/ACC 2026：血栓性抗磷脂综合征首选华法林。当年与现在：报告从肝素转华法林与现行做法一致，但没有记录目标 INR、疗程和抗体复查。
teachingPoints.en: Long term: warfarin, not a DOAC. ESC 2019: indefinite VKA for APS (class I) and no NOACs in APS (class III); overlap with parenteral anticoagulation for at least 5 days and until the INR is 2.0–3.0. EULAR 2019: long-term VKA with a target INR of 2–3 after a first unprovoked venous event; no rivaroxaban in triple positivity. AHA/ACC 2026: warfarin for thrombotic APS. Then and now: the report's move from heparin to warfarin matches; it records no INR target, duration or repeat antibody test.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 激素与血小板。ASH 2019 对新诊断的成人免疫性血小板减少症、血小板 ≥ 30×10⁹/L 且无出血或仅有轻微皮肤黏膜出血者推荐观察而不是糖皮质激素（强推荐，证据确定性很低）；她的血小板减少由来已久，58×10⁹/L 且无明显出血，看不出用激素的理由，而激素也不能治疗血栓。当年与现在：报告在抗凝的同时用了激素并逐渐停用，血小板随后改善——单例报告不能说明这是激素的作用。
teachingPoints.en: Steroids and the platelet count. ASH 2019 recommends observation rather than corticosteroids for adults with newly diagnosed immune thrombocytopenia and platelets ≥ 30 × 10⁹/L with no or only minor mucocutaneous bleeding (strong recommendation, very low certainty); her low platelets were long-standing, and 58 × 10⁹/L without significant bleeding gives no reason for steroids — which do not treat thrombosis. Then and now: the report gave steroids alongside the anticoagulation and tapered them, and the platelets improved — a single case cannot show that the steroid caused it.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 生育计划是处方的一部分。华法林可能伤害胎儿：开始前排除妊娠，确认怀孕后尽快改为低分子肝素。ACR 2020：抗磷脂抗体阳性者不用复方雌孕激素避孕药，可用宫内节育器或单纯孕激素口服片。EULAR 2019：血栓性抗磷脂综合征孕期用小剂量阿司匹林加治疗剂量肝素。当年与现在：报告没有记录避孕和妊娠计划，也没有记录那次死胎的孕周。
teachingPoints.en: Pregnancy planning is part of the prescription. Warfarin can harm a fetus: exclude pregnancy before starting and change to LMWH as soon as pregnancy is confirmed. ACR 2020: no combined oestrogen–progestin contraception with antiphospholipid antibodies; an intrauterine device or a progestogen-only pill instead. EULAR 2019: low-dose aspirin plus treatment-dose heparin through pregnancy in thrombotic APS. Then and now: the report records no contraception or pregnancy plan, nor the gestation of her stillbirth.
